## Request

## Brief

A change request against a finished run. Detection assumes an existing `.song/nobody-knows-my-name-here/state.json` with `status: complete` (and `.song/active` naming that slug); the request names a section, so REVISE re-enters at Stage 4 scoped to the Chorus, then runs Stages 5 and 6 as light passes and Stage 7 in full. With no finished run present the same sentence would be classified by the remaining rows instead.
